Definition
[$W^{1,p}(0,T;X)$ and $H^1(0,T;X)$] ↗ def:lp-time-banach-space ↗ def:weak-derivative-banach-valued 1. ch5:5.9-def-6\group Bochner Spaces

(i) The Sobolev space \[ W^{1,p}(0,T;X) \] consists of all functions $u \in L^p(0,T;X)$ such that $u'$ exists in the weak sense and belongs to $L^p(0,T;X)$. Furthermore, \[ \| u\| _{W^{1,p}(0,T;X)} := \begin{cases} \left(\int _0^T \| u(t)\| ^p + \| u’(t)\| ^p \, dt\right)^{1/p} & (1 \le p < \infty ) \\ \text{ess sup}_{0 \le t \le T}(\| u(t)\| + \| u’(t)\| ) & (p = \infty ). \end{cases} \]

(ii) We write $H^1(0,T;X) = W^{1,2}(0,T;X)$.
